loader_policy: exact SONAMEs from the certified prefix only; no module fallback

rationale.torch: torch 2.0.1+cu118 is the unchanged CPython-3.10 Linux cu118 wheel from the PyTorch CUDA 11.8 index
rationale.dgl: DGL 1.1.1+cu118 directly links libcudart.so.11.0, libcublas.so.11 and libcusparse.so.11
rationale.cuda_components: Actual CUDA-11 wheel METADATA shows cuSPARSE has no Requires-Dist entry and cuSOLVER requires only nvidia-cublas-cu11. CUDA-12 nvJitLink packaging is not part of this CUDA-11 graph.
rationale.scope: External cuDNN, NCCL, NVRTC, cuFFT, cuRAND, CUPTI and NVTX wheels are not required by DGL's direct links or the single-GPU preflight; torch retains its own cu118 wheel payload.
rationale.integrity: Every downloaded Linux wheel is version- and SHA-256-locked; certification additionally records each resolved shared-library SHA-256.
